name: auryn-grpc
summary: Language-agnostic gRPC/Protobuf contract stitch for Auryn: a post-ingestion hook that parses .proto service contracts and links a client's RPC call and a server's handler Method to the shared contract across languages (caller -CALLS_RPC-> RpcMethod <-IMPLEMENTS_RPC- handler). The RPC analog of the HTTP call<->endpoint seam; ties microservices written in different languages. Depends only on auryn-core.
